issues.display_title: Issue #4286: feat(crm): Replace mock CRM store with real API layer (useCrm hooks + service swap)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Replace the mock CRM store (src/mocks/crm.js — localStorage + useSyncExternalStore) with a real API layer for the CRM feature. This is the foundation task for the CRM integration (BE tasks GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877–#1883). Branch: design/add-CRM-section-menu.

Background

The CRM UI ships on this branch (page /crm, Tour Detail CRM section, ClientBadge) and currently reads/writes src/mocks/crm.js. The mock's export surface was designed so the swap stays contained:

Mock export Real API (BE issue)
useCrm() → { clients, tourClients } GET /v1/crm/clients (#1877) — tours_count is embedded in the response, so the FE no longer needs the tourClients map
saveClient(client) POST /v1/crm/clients (#1878) / PUT /v1/crm/clients/{id} (#1879)
deleteClient(id) DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id} (#1880)
assignTourClient(mid, clientId|null) PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (#1883) — null = unassign
useTourClient(mid) — Tour Detail GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (#1881)
useTourClient(mid) — TourCard badge GET /v1/crm/tours/clients?mids=… batch (#1882)
clientName(client) helper stays client-side (pure function, keep as-is)

Tasks

  1. Create src/hooks/useCrm.jsx (or src/services/CrmService.js) using the existing useRequest hooks (useLazyFetch, usePost, usePut, useDelete) with URLs /v1/crm/clients, /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client, /v1/crm/tours/clients — follow the useAccounts.jsx pattern.
  2. Preserve the mock's export surface so Crm.jsx, ClientContact.jsx, ClientFormModal.jsx, ClientBadge.jsx, and TourSummary.jsx keep working with minimal diff (same prop/state shapes; client object shape is already identical to the API response: first_name, last_name, company, email, phone).
  3. Re-export a temporary shim in src/mocks/crm.js that delegates to the new hooks, or move all import sites in the same PR — pick one, no mixed usage.
  4. Encrypted envelope responses are handled transparently by src/utils/request.js — no extra decrypt wiring.
  5. Keep translations (t_crm.* keys) untouched.

Dependencies

  • BE endpoint readiness: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877 (list — includes the schema + scaffold prerequisites)

Acceptance

  • No CRM code path reads from localStorage anymore (gothru_mock_crm key unused)
  • All 4 mock exports mapped to the real endpoints
  • Errors surfaced via existing useToast error toasts (no silent failures)

Result

  • Pull Request: #4318 (target base: development)
  • Implementation:
    • Created src/hooks/useCrm.jsx integrating all 7 backend CRM endpoints using useLazyFetch, usePost, usePut, and useDelete.
    • Implemented useCrm() providing fetchClients, createClient, updateClient, saveClient, deleteClient, fetchTourClient, fetchBatchTourClients, and assignTourClient.
    • Implemented useTourClient(mid) with real-time sync across components via custom event gothru:crm-tour-changed.
    • Exported pure helper clientName(client).
    • src/mocks/crm.js converted into a backward-compatible shim re-exporting from useCrm.jsx with zero localStorage access (gothru_mock_crm key unused).
  • Verification:
    • 11 unit tests passing in src/hooks/useCrm.test.jsx.
    • ESLint passing clean.
    • Production build compiled successfully.

issues.display_title: Issue #4287: feat(crm): Integrate CRM page with real client CRUD APIs (list, add/edit, delete)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the CRM page (pages/Crm/Crm.jsx) with the real client CRUD APIs, replacing the mock usage for the list + create + edit + delete flows. Branch: design/add-CRM-section-menu.

Background

The CRM page UI is already built (table, search, pagination, add/edit modal, delete confirm modal) and currently reads/writes src/mocks/crm.js. The API layer swap is tracked separately (#4286).

Tasks

  1. List + search + pagination — wire the table to GET /v1/crm/clients (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877): server-driven search, page, limit=10 (FE PAGE_SIZE); render tours_count column from the embedded response (drop the client-side tourClients counting).
  2. Create — wire ClientFormModal add mode to POST /v1/crm/clients (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1878); refresh the list after save.
  3. Edit — same modal, edit mode → PUT /v1/crm/clients/{id} (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1879).
  4. Delete — confirm modal → DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id} (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1880); use the unlinked_tours response value for the unlink confirmation copy (t_crm.t_delete.t_unlink).
  5. Success/error feedback via existing useToast (success titles already wired).

Dependencies

  • #4286 (API layer)
  • BE: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877, #1878, #1879, #1880

Acceptance

  • Table renders real clients with server pagination + search
  • Add/edit saves via API and list refreshes
  • Delete unlinks tours (server-side) and reflects the count in the confirm copy
  • Empty state & search-empty state still render correctly

Result

  • Pull Request: #4318 (target base: development)
  • Implementation:
    • Connected src/pages/Crm/Crm.jsx to real backend API GET /v1/crm/clients with server-side pagination (PAGE_SIZE = 10) and debounced search.
    • Updated table to render tours_count directly from server response payload.
    • Integrated ClientFormModal for creating (POST /v1/crm/clients) and updating (PUT /v1/crm/clients/{id}) clients with auto-refresh.
    • Wired hard delete (DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id}) displaying unlinked tours confirmation copy.
  • Verification:
    • Unit tests passing in src/pages/Crm/Crm.test.jsx.
    • Verified live E2E flow against dev database with account muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com.

issues.display_title: Issue #4288: feat(crm): Integrate Tour Detail CRM section with assign/unassign APIs
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the Tour Detail CRM section (ClientContact.jsx in the tour detail page, between Google Publish and Tags) with the real assign/unassign APIs, replacing the mock store. Branch: design/add-CRM-section-menu.

Background

The CRM Contact card is already built: client dropdown (avatar + name + company items), assigned-client detail table (Name / Company / Email / Phone), "+ Add new" quick action, and a "remove selected" button when a client is assigned. It currently reads/writes src/mocks/crm.js.

Tasks

  1. Dropdown source — fill the Select with GET /v1/crm/clients (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877) instead of the mock client list.
  2. Assign / unassign — onSelectionChange → PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1883): send client_id on select, null when the placeholder/none is picked; keep the current toasts (t_assigned / t_unassigned).
  3. Remove selected — "remove selected" button → same endpoint with client_id: null (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1883).
  4. Add new — "+ Add new" opens ClientFormModal; on save → POST /v1/crm/clients (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1878) then auto-assign the new client via PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (preserves the mock's onSaved → assignTourClient behavior).
  5. Detail display — assigned client details from GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1881).

Dependencies

  • #4286 (API layer)
  • BE: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1877, #1878, #1881, #1883

Acceptance

  • Dropdown lists real clients (search/select works, anchorKey handling preserved)
  • Selecting a client persists after page reload
  • Unassign via dropdown none/placeholder and via "remove selected" both work
  • Add-new-from-here creates a client and assigns it to the tour
  • No mock import left in ClientContact.jsx

Result

  • Pull Request: #4318 (target base: development)
  • Implementation:
    • Integrated src/components/organism/Crm/ClientContact.jsx on Tour Detail (/my-tours/:mid) with real APIs.
    • Client dropdown dynamically populated from GET /v1/crm/clients.
    • Assign / unassign wired to PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (client_id or null).
    • "+ Add new" modal creates client and automatically assigns them to current tour.
    • Assigned client details table displays Name, Company, Email, Phone directly from server.
    • Unassign button ("Remove Selected CRM") unlinks client cleanly.
  • Verification:
    • Unit tests passing in src/components/organism/Crm/ClientContact.test.jsx.
    • Verified live E2E flow against tour 3556442.

issues.display_title: Issue #4289: feat(crm): Integrate ClientBadge (TourCard batch + TourSummary) with client lookup APIs
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the ClientBadge chip ("Client: Name") on the tours list cards (TourCard.jsx) and the tour detail header (TourSummary.jsx) with the real APIs, replacing the mock store. Branch: design/add-CRM-section-menu.

Background

ClientBadge renders nothing when the tour has no client (already implemented) and currently reads/writes src/mocks/crm.js.

Tasks

  1. Tours list (TourCard) — batch fetch per page: GET /v1/crm/tours/clients?mids=<up to 100> (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1882) once when the tours list renders, feed the map into ClientBadge via context/prop instead of per-card useTourClient(mid) lookups; missing mids map to null (badge stays hidden).
  2. Tour detail header (TourSummary) — single fetch: GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client (GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1881).
  3. Badge visibility must follow server data: no client assigned → no chip.
  4. Re-fetch/refresh strategy: badge data should refresh after assign/unassign in the Tour Detail CRM section (same page) — either shared cache or event/reload.

Dependencies

  • #4286 (API layer)
  • BE: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1881, #1882

Acceptance

  • List tour shows one batch request per page (no N requests per card)
  • Badge appears/disappears per assignment state
  • Assign/unassign from Tour Detail updates the badge without a full reload
  • No mock import left in ClientBadge.jsx / TourSummary.jsx

Result

  • Pull Request: #4318 (target base: development)
  • Implementation:
    • Updated TourCard.jsx and src/pages/Tour/List/List.jsx to batch-fetch client mappings for all tours on the page via GET /v1/crm/tours/clients?mids=... in a single request (no N per-card calls).
    • Updated ClientBadge.jsx to support injected client prop or single lookup on demand via useTourClient(mid).
    • Wired TourSummary.jsx header badge with ClientBadge, syncing in real time on assignment/unassignment via event bus without requiring a page reload.
    • Removed all mock imports from ClientBadge.jsx, TourCard.jsx, and TourSummary.jsx.
  • Verification:
    • Unit tests passing in src/components/organism/Crm/ClientBadge.test.jsx.
    • Verified live batch request and real-time header sync in E2E testing.

issues.display_title: Issue #4317: feat(auth): Keycloak SSO Integration - Pass Refresh Token & Backchannel Logout
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/gothru-sso#13 (Task 4: User Session & Identity Updates)
Ref API: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1930

Summary

Pass Keycloak refresh token and refresh token lifetime from code exchange directly to the backend login endpoint (POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login) so the server can securely persist it in Redis, keep browser storage 100% token-free, and support pure backchannel global logout.

Scope

  • In src/pages/Auth/KeycloakCallback.jsx:
    • Pass refresh_token and refresh_expires_in directly to POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login.
    • Remove id_token storage in sessionStorage (kc_id_token), keeping browser storage completely token-free.
  • In src/components/Header.jsx:
    • Switch logout to pure backchannel: trigger backend logout via handleLogout and redirect directly to /auth.
    • Remove front-channel browser redirect to Keycloak end-session URL.

Acceptance Criteria

  • refresh_token and refresh_expires_in are passed to backend login payload when present.
  • Keycloak tokens (access_token, refresh_token, id_token) are NOT saved to browser localStorage or sessionStorage.
  • Logout performs pure backchannel via backend API without front-channel Keycloak redirect.
  • Unit tests pass (KeycloakCallback.test.jsx, Header.countly.test.jsx, keycloakAuth.test.js).
  • Production build compiles cleanly.

Result

Implemented and merged via #4316.

  • KeycloakCallback.jsx:
    • Updated authorization code exchange handler to extract refresh_token and refresh_expires_in from Keycloak token response and pass them directly to POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login.
    • Removed client-side persistence of id_token in sessionStorage (kc_id_token), ensuring the frontend storage remains 100% token-free adhering strictly to Task 13 security requirements.
  • Header.jsx:
    • Switched logout flow to pure backchannel: user logout triggers backend handleLogout API call (POST /v1/auth/logout), which handles session revocation with Keycloak server-to-server.
    • Removed browser front-channel redirect to Keycloak end-session URL; user is redirected directly to ${window.location.origin}/auth seamlessly without URL flicker.
  • Unit Tests & Build:
    • KeycloakCallback.test.jsx: Updated tests to verify refresh token and expiry handoff to backend, and verified zero tokens are saved in sessionStorage.
    • Header.countly.test.jsx: Updated logout tests to verify direct redirection to /auth and identity reset upon backchannel logout completion.
    • keycloakAuth.test.js: All helpers passing 100%.
    • All Jest test suites passed (29/29 tests).
    • npm run build passed cleanly.
